These are reference facts, not answer fields. The answer selects item numbers; the code joins their descriptions and measurements after parsing.","\"item_keys\" — what the keys in «candidates» mean, and defaults for omitted values; read every item by these keys; restore every absent key that has an `absent =` default","\"verdict\" — your outfits and the code's check: «your_outfit» — item numbers and your caption; «structure.blockers» — what keeps the outfit from being shown, each under its «id»: a missing kind of item, with «options» — the «n» of the «showcase» items that fill it; or several items of one kind, with «items»","\"showcase\" — item numbers that can fill what is missing","\"statements\" — what the code found: each entry is {code, values, …}; codes are defined in \"statement_codes\"","knowledge_legend joins knowledge to the actual items in this request. sections keys are JSON Pointer paths from this request root (~0 means ~, ~1 means /). A section with rows has one knowledge vector per row of that list/table, in the exact same order; a table's cols/rows represent logical item rows. A section with item gives the vector for that single item. null means no knowledge supplied. Vector indices refer to facts in property order. defaults is the explicit complete three-index vector: append its trailing indices to a shorter vector; a scalar is a one-index vector. Only explicitly listed items use defaults. Each fact is [descriptor index, value]; each descriptor is [status, source, applicability index]. applicability records give applicability and its source. Applicability is independent of status; unknown never proves NA. measured: known value from that source; range: only that window/alternatives; unknown: no supported fact; not_applicable: explicit inapplicability. Only status=measured with literal value=\"absent\" states explicit absence; a missing value or field never does. Color range value is [L0,L1,C0,C1,hue arc or null], never a measured hex centre. Composition_raw means unparsed shop text, never coded composition. Metal unknown never proves no metal. A value {field, conversion} references that same item's existing field: lab is the exact Lab value; hex uses colorspace.hx (sRGB to CIELab D65); hx_round2 uses the existing feed producer's two-decimal representation after hx. A reference is emitted only when it reconstructs the original value exactly."],"statement_codes":{"no_bag":"no bag, and the occasion requires
